For full consideration of a job opening, ensure all required materials are completed by the deadline listed. *For the best results during the application process, Chrome is the recommended browser. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Bismarck State College does not provide sponsorships. BSC determines employment eligibility through the E-Verify system. Questions? Contact Human Resources at 701-224-5531 or email: bsc.humanresources@bismarckstate.edu. Adjunct Inquiries Are you interested in teaching as an Adjunct? Our Human Resources department does not always know when adjunct positions become available, and we do not always advertise for adjunct positions. Frequently, Assistant Deans will look at applications they have received and will contact applicants directly if a position becomes available. To be considered for an adjunct position, complete the online application for the "Adjunct" position and upload the following: Resume Transcripts-copies are acceptable, official would be required if hired (transcripts will be reviewed to ensure minimum degree/course requirements meet Higher Learning Commission (HLC) standards). Once we receive your application it will be forwarded to the Assistant Dean to ensure you meet HLC standards. We will be in contact with you. Current Employees Employees at BSC or other ND University System institutions – log in to Employee Self Service and navigate to the Careers tile to view all job opportunities, including internal postings. Employee Benefits There are a number of advantages to being part of our community: Our students are talented. Our alumni are engaged. Campus buzzes with excitement. BSC is large enough to provide a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, yet small enough that each individual’s skills and talent contribute to the College’s overall success.
